items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Rio de Janeiro (RJ) is procuring healthcare goods or services through electronic pregão (reverse auction); proposals close Nov 26, 10:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
